verdict.rationale: IRCC publishes at least one exact filing deadline: Start-up Visa applicants with a valid 2025 commitment certificate must apply by June 30, 2026. The evidence shows no penalty or interest schedule for missing deadlines, and no broader published set of filing deadlines. The penalty-and-interest part of the story fits a tax authority more than an immigration agency, so only the deadline part is clearly evidenced. Missing for 10: published penalty and interest schedule with exact figures, comprehensive filing-deadline listings beyond one program, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, the filing deadlines and the penalty and interest schedule for missing them are published with exact figures

citations.quote: have a valid 2025 commitment certificate apply by June 30, 2026
